answers.how: The tire diameter is about 44 px and the rocket length about 98 px: 2.9 × 44/98 ≈ 1.30.
Scaling tracked rocket positions by 2.9 m per 98 px and fitting its accelerated motion gives an average speed of about 14.1 m/s over 0–1.167 s.
The scaled position-versus-time fit gives v(t) ≈ 4.0 + 17.3t m/s, hence v(1) ≈ 21.3 m/s.
A quadratic fit to the rocket's pixel positions, converted using its 2.9 m length, gives approximately constant acceleration of 17.3 m/s².
